calories.description: Gross energy content per 100g calculated from Atwater factors or bomb calorimetry.

protein_g.description: Total protein content calculated from total nitrogen x protein conversion factor.
protein_g.nutriq_role: Macronutrient goal tracking and muscle synthesis

carbs_g.description: Total carbohydrates calculated by difference: 100 - (water + protein + fat + ash + alcohol).

fat_g.description: Total lipid content extracted through standard ether or saponification assay.
fat_g.nutriq_role: Essential fatty acids and lipid energy balance

vitamin_d_mcg.conversion_formula: If ID 1114 is null and ID 1110 (IU) is present: mcg = IU / 40.0. If 1111 and 1112 present: mcg = D2 + D3.
vitamin_d_mcg.description: Ergocalciferol (D2) plus Cholecalciferol (D3) expressed in micrograms.
vitamin_d_mcg.nutriq_role: Critical tracked biomarker for bone health and deficiency risk modeling

iron_mg.description: Elemental iron (heme + non-heme) measured via atomic absorption spectrophotometry / ICP-MS.
iron_mg.nutriq_role: Critical tracked biomarker for anemia and oxygen transport

zinc_mg.description: Elemental zinc measured via atomic absorption spectrophotometry / ICP-MS.
zinc_mg.nutriq_role: Critical tracked biomarker for immune function and cellular metabolism

b12_mcg.description: Total cobalamin compounds measured via microbiological assay or LC-MS.
b12_mcg.nutriq_role: Critical tracked biomarker for neurological health and red blood cell formation
